mapper.select: SELECT cs.session_id AS sessionId, cs.session_name AS sessionName, cs.update_time AS updateTime, ( SELECT ch.content FROM t_chat_history ch WHERE ch.session_id = cs.session_id ORDER BY ch.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS lastContent FROM t_chat_session cs WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cs.update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
